consequence.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 HelmRepository schema, status.artifact.digest is now a required field, so the API server rejects objects or status writes that set status.artifact without a digest.
consequence.remediation: Make sure every client or controller that writes HelmRepository v1beta2 status fills in status.artifact.digest.

original.statement: The source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 HelmRepository CRD schema now requires status.artifact.digest, so objects that leave it out are rejected.

decision.reason: The validators confirm from the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] that status.artifact.digest becomes required in the HelmRepository v1beta2 schema. The computed diff says objects that omit it are rejected, so resource-rejected (action) fits. The statement correctly limits the rejection to writes that set status.artifact without a digest, because the required field sits inside status.artifact. Low severity is reasonable because only status writes are affected. This matches known fact vf-a5cc22f29e7f, but nothing here shows it comes from the same release pair, so I judged it on its merits instead of rejecting it as a duplicate.
